script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Locate the target quf.py tool relative to this script
QUF_BASE=$(dirname "$(realpath "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")
QUF_PATH="$QUF_BASE/tools/quf.py"
if [[ ! -f "$QUF_PATH" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Missing tools/quf.py!" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Isolated temp working directory (auto-cleaned on exit)
TMP_WORK=$(mktemp -d -t quf-abuse-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP_WORK"' EXIT
cd "$TMP_WORK" || exit 1

# Generate hostile test assets
echo 'this is not valid JSON' > invalid.json
touch empty.json
echo -e '{"key": "\x00\x01\x7f\xff"}' > control_chars.json
printf '{"iter": "%s"}\n' {1..20000} > huge.json
touch -- "-leading-dash.json" "file with spaces.json" $'newline\nfile.json' $'carriage\rreturn.json'
head -c 1024 /dev/urandom > corrupt.quf
mkdir -p "test_dir"

# Trigger every abuse vector
# 1. Bad top-level flags
python3 "$QUF_PATH" --fake 2>/dev/null || true
# 2. Fake subcommand
python3 "$QUF_PATH" not-a-real-subcommand 2>/dev/null || true
# 3. Create subcommand abuse
python3 "$QUF_PATH" create 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" create invalid.json 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" create invalid.json out.quf extra-arg 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" create empty.json out-empty.quf 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" create control_chars.json out-control.quf --digest 2>/dev/null || true
cat invalid.json | python3 "$QUF_PATH" create - out-stdin.quf 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" create "test_dir" out-dir-input.quf 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" create "-leading-dash.json" out-flag-file.quf 2>/dev/null || true
# 4. Info subcommand abuse
python3 "$QUF_PATH" info 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" info invalid.json 2>/dev/null || true
ln -s nonexistent broken-symlink
python3 "$QUF_PATH" info broken-symlink 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" info $'carriage\rreturn.json' 2>/dev/null || true
# 5. Dump subcommand abuse
python3 "$QUF_PATH" dump 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" dump invalid.json dump.txt 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" dump corrupt.quf dump.txt extra-flag 2>/dev/null || true
# 6. Verify subcommand abuse
python3 "$QUF_PATH" verify 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" verify corrupt.quf 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" verify invalid.json 2>/dev/null || true
# 7. Hex subcommand abuse
python3 "$QUF_PATH" hex 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" hex corrupt.quf hex.txt 2>/dev/null || true
python3 "$QUF_PATH" hex huge.json hex-huge.txt &
HXD_PID=$!
sleep 0.1
kill "$HXD_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
# 8. Piped hostile input
head -c 1024 /dev/urandom | python3 "$QUF_PATH" create - out-rand.quf 2>/dev/null || true
# 9. Interrupted selftest
python3 "$QUF_PATH" selftest &
ST_PID=$!
sleep 0.1
kill "$ST_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
